message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded FCS files or pickled datasets before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local filesystem paths only; no remote sources are used and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the local files either.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are assigned solely based on whether 'CLL' appears in the filename with no distribution check, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool applied.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code reads raw FCS files and copies values directly into numpy arrays with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pickled dataset files via pickle.load without any hash check, signature verification, or integrity validation on those files, and no pretrained model weights are loaded with any integrity control.

No detected label distribution validation: The code assigns labels based on filename strings ('CLL' check) but never validates class balance, checks for expected label sets, or detects anomalous label distributions before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is used; the models train with standard optimizers without any privacy guarantees.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split appears to exist in the base model, the evaluation reports only a single accuracy metric with no hashing, signing of evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation; additionally, the NeuralNet/ConvNet select the best model based on cross-val s

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on the dataset or labels before passing them to the models; pickle files are loaded and used directly without any checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (accuracy scores) are returned and printed directly with no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks applied.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used (Random Forest, Decision Tree, Neural Net, CNN, XGBoost) are not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
